actions.step: Increased retry attempts from 5 to 8
Enabled 60-second fraud score cache and reduced retries to 2 with jitter

postmortem: Aggressive retries turned a small overage into a storm of throttled calls, and raising them made it worse. Caching repeat scores and adding jitter brought the call rate back under the vendor limit.

root_cause: payments-api closed idle connections after 5 seconds while the ingress reused keepalive connections for up to 60 seconds, so requests were sent on connections the server had just closed.

actions.step: Restarted ingress-nginx pods
Set payments-api keepalive timeout to 75s, above the ingress upstream keepalive
